ctaHeading: Taylors Hill plasterers are ready — let's fix your ceilings.
aboutText: With over 15 years of experience, The Master Plasterers Taylors Hill provides top-quality ceiling and wall repairs to Taylors Hill and surrounding western suburbs. We specialise in plasterboard installation, water damage restoration, and all aspects of plastering. Our team is committed to delivering exceptional craftsmanship and customer satisfaction for both residential and commercial projects.
servicesText: We offer a comprehensive range of plastering services tailored to the needs of Taylors Hill residents. Whether you need ceiling repairs after water damage or new plasterboard installation, our experts ensure durable and aesthetically pleasing results.

services.title: Ceiling Repairs & Replacement
